{"reason": "Failure rows show two unknown patterns that are truly demand-forecast-error: market-mismatch=#t with no bias flag, and forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 just under the 0.1 gate. Adding market-signal-mismatch? as an alternate trigger and lowering the bias threshold to 0.05 recovers those claims, raising accuracy and recovered amount.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
